title: Start hook warns when the cloud snapshot is behind main
why: A stale snapshot makes every new lane print old warnings and run old hooks.
note: Coordinator 12:41 CST: warn once when the snapshot's claude-settings is behind main by a commit that changed install.sh or hooks/, and name the fix (Edit the environment, save the Setup script). The snapshot holds d7eb5c94 (Nov 4 07:09 UTC), before #1195; 31 lanes print the old EXECPATH line (measured).
